payload.scientific_problem: Does the frozen generic anchored-replacement option transfer useful JAK2 docking chemistry from answer-known seed 1 to independently generated eligible endpoints on seed 0?
payload.primary_model_output: One complete eligible COMPOSE endpoint from the prospectively frozen JAK2 seed-0 anchored-replacement pool.
payload.central_claim_under_test: The generic coordinated deletion-retained-anchor-ring-construction option transfers docking utility to a second source, rather than only reproducing the seed-1 development basin.
payload.validation_setting: Twelve score-blind, exact-historical-novel, diversity-locked endpoints; one JAK2 docking call each; no retry, replacement or adaptation.
payload.declared_support: JAK2 seed 0 at delta 0.6, compose_valid endpoint support, frozen anchored-replacement programs with exact execution; this pilot does not test seed 2, FiberControl, route distillation or benchmark-wide performance.

authorization.basis: The user explicitly instructed us to freeze anchored replacement, test the remaining JAK2 seeds quickly, approved Modal use, and directed continued aggressive development toward IVG-beating performance.
authorization.scope: Exactly the 12 candidates in the immutable lock, one docking attempt per endpoint, no retry or replacement.

promotion_and_kill_criteria.engineering: All 12 locked endpoints are attempted exactly once and every result, including a failure, is retained.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.utility: At least one successful candidate scores at or below the published IVG mean of -9.7.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.strong_transfer: At least one successful candidate scores at or below -10.2, the published delta-0.4 IVG mean on this cell.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.negative: If no candidate reaches -9.7, retain the negative result and do not infer cross-source docking transfer from proposal support alone.

payload.claim_boundary: Prospective bounded development evidence on one second-source JAK2 cell. It is not a held-out benchmark result, not replicated, and not evidence for FiberControl or route distillation.
